header.description: French Citizen, born in 1969. Living in Switzerland (permit C) near Lausanne. Engineer with 2 Master's degrees.
header.title: Product · Design · Engineering

events.title: VP, Design & Innovation
events.description: Promoted to VP level to lead a focused 5-person Design & Innovation team — a deliberate shift from large-scale org management back to strategic depth. Concentrating on product vision and strategic features for the SOPHiA DDM platform: combining design leadership, product strategy, and the data visualisation craft built over twelve years as a founding contributor to the platform.

events.title: Natural Language Processing with Classification and Vector Spaces
events.description: Sentiment analysis, translation, word embeddings and vector space models for NLP tasks.

events.title: Head of Platform Product & Engineering
events.description: Expanded leadership role combining full Platform Product Management with engineering org leadership — managing a 25-person organisation (developers, Product Owners, UX/UI designers) with 5 direct reports. Owned the DDM platform as Product Owner while steering the team through the completion of the GEN1→GEN2 migration: from JavaFX desktop to React web, including a fundamental redesign of the clinical interaction paradigm. Aligned stakeholders, defined user flows, and oversaw frontend architecture to deliver high-impact features. Built metrics and dashboards to track both development team performance and customer migration progress — applying the data analytics lens directly to engineering management.

events.title: AI for Medical Diagnosis
events.description: Applied deep learning for medical image analysis, disease detection, and diagnostic model evaluation.

events.title: Head of Product Owners, UX/UI
events.description: Returned to SOPHiA GENETICS to lead a 7-person Product Owners and UX/UI team, heading the product and design side of the GEN2 platform — a full rewrite of the original GEN1 JavaFX desktop application into a React web architecture with microservices backend. Built end-to-end the multimodal prototype for oncologists: a proof of concept moving the platform beyond single-omics genomics into a unified clinical view combining radiomics, digital pathology, and clinical data — then led the full delivery program to scale it with the development team. Delivered the company's first React web application, pioneering the platform's transition to web. For the first time, worked within a structured product organisation with dedicated PO and UX specialists — a maturation of the product function bootstrapped during the GEN1 era.

events.title: Product Manager
events.description: Brief engagement as Product Manager at GenomSys, a Swiss startup building clinical tools around the MPEG-G standard (ISO/IEC 23092) — the international specification for efficient genomic data compression, access control, and unified data containers for sequencing data. Brought deep clinical genomics domain expertise from seven years at SOPHiA GENETICS to assess product strategy and positioning for this emerging standard. After three months, concluded the engagement following strategic differences on product direction — and accepted an invitation from SOPHiA GENETICS to return and continue the platform mission.

events.title: Professional Scrum Product Owner (PSPO I)
events.description: Fundamental understanding of the Scrum framework and how to maximise value delivered with a product as a Product Owner.

events.title: Deep Learning Specialization
events.description: Five-course specialization covering the foundations of deep learning, neural network architectures, and practical ML engineering.
achievements: Improving Deep Neural Networks: Hyperparameter Tuning, Regularization and Optimization (Sep 2019)

events.title: JavaScript Algorithms and Data Structures
events.description: JavaScript fundamentals, ES6, regular expressions, debugging, data structures, algorithm scripting, and functional programming.

events.title: VP Functional & UX Design
events.description: First VP-level role at SOPHiA GENETICS, leading the evolution of the SOPHiA DDM Platform at the intersection of AI and clinical genomics. Owned end-to-end functional requirements for data-driven features and workflows, managed the feature backlog with explicit prioritisation by impact, feasibility, and data readiness, and established a rigorous quality-focused sign-off process. Built UI prototypes in D3.js and Balsamiq to validate AI and data concepts before committing to development — cutting feedback cycles on high-stakes clinical features. Worked hands-on with delivery teams to reduce ambiguity and maintain momentum, combining product leadership with direct technical contribution.

events.title: Introduction to the Biology of Cancer
events.description: Molecular biology of cancer, oncogenes, tumor suppressor genes, and the hallmarks of cancer. Risk factors for major cancers worldwide.

events.title: Head of Front-End Development
events.description: Continued leading the evolution of the GEN1 platform with a 4-person team — still acting as both product owner and hands-on developer: defining features, owning functional specifications, assigning tasks, and writing code. Built the internal admin web app used by the Support team, and contributed to two CTI/Innosuisse innovation projects. On personal initiative, built a D3.js gene/transcript viewer and a suite of internal data apps — including a real-time global usage map and stats dashboards — making platform data legible across the whole company. A five-year chapter building the platform from the ground up, as engineer, product thinker, and team lead simultaneously.

events.title: R Programming
events.description: R programming fundamentals for data analysis and statistical computing.

events.title: Data Visualisation Engineer
events.description: Joined SOPHiA GENETICS as one of its first ten employees and became the primary driver behind what would later be known as the GEN1 platform — the company's foundational clinical genomics platform. Operated simultaneously as Product Owner, product thinker, and hands-on developer: defining what to build, assigning development tasks to the team, and writing core code. Drove the migration from web to a Java/JavaFX desktop application, owning architecture, UI framework, and implementation. Also designed and built a dynamic circular genomic viewer in D3.js and HTML5 — a Circos-style multi-layer visualisation displaying SNVs/INDELs across coverage, gene transcripts, and clinical annotation databases, bringing complex variant data directly to clinical users.

events.title: Data Visualisation & Web Developer
events.description: Freelance data visualization project for the International AIDS Society (IAS) — designed and built an interactive world map visualizing global data from an online database of paediatric HIV cohorts, turning complex epidemiological datasets into a clear, accessible experience on the IAS website. Built with D3.js, SVG, and JavaScript.

events.title: Introduction to Infographics and Data Visualization

events.description: Data Journalism and Visualization with Free Tools.

events.description: Business Analysis Body of Knowledge (BABOK) — core concepts, knowledge areas, tasks and techniques for professional business analysis practice.

events.title: Senior Software Engineer
events.description: Three-year freelance engagement at Pictet Asset Management, one of Europe's leading independent asset managers, delivering business and technical analysis alongside full-stack development. Contributed to a web-based CRM for the asset management division, and led the end-to-end analysis, design, and implementation of a new cash-management module within the Portfolio Management System — covering both server and client layers. Consistently operated at the intersection of business and engineering: translating stakeholder needs into functional specifications, then carrying them through to production-ready features.

events.title: Photography — Sabbatical & Visual Studies
events.description: A deliberate year out to invest in visual thinking and composition — studied photography through formal courses and structured self-study grounded in foundational works by Stephen Shore, Harald Mante, and Michael Freeman. Grounded theory in practice through a 4-month photo-reporter internship at the Police Cantonale Vaudoise, documenting events with factual precision. Went on to serve as official photographer for La Nuit des Musées de Lausanne for four consecutive years (2009–2012). The visual discipline, attention to composition, and practice of communicating clearly through images directly informed later work in UX design and data visualization.

events.title: Senior Software Engineer
events.description: Freelance engagement at RTS — Radio Télévision Suisse, architecting and building a workflow-based collaborative application for fully digital, tapeless TV production — a significant industry transition at the time. Defined the use-case catalog, system architecture, component and framework selection, and delivery plan before writing a single line of code. Delivered the design and core implementation, integrating production data flows through a REST-based integration layer. Architecture-first delivery on a greenfield system, in a domain where reliability and workflow continuity directly affect broadcast output.

events.title: Senior Software Engineer
events.description: Consultant engagement at Neo Technologies, re-engineering their proprietary electricity-management logistics platform to support third-party integration and extend coverage to gas and cable infrastructure for internet and telecom services. Began with a full reverse-engineering of the legacy system — extracting use cases, sequence diagrams, and class diagrams — before leading stakeholder interviews to surface new requirements and define the expanded platform's specifications. Delivered the full architecture, design, and implementation across the entire delivery cycle: system analyst, solution architect, and engineer.

events.title: Senior Software Engineer
events.description: Consultant engagement at Pictet & Cie, one of Europe's most prestigious independent private banks, building the batch-processing backbone of the Portfolio Management System (PMS). Designed an asynchronous server-based framework using EJB message-driven beans on WebLogic to execute and monitor complex financial computation tasks. Defined a cross-application change-notification system, including a cache-invalidation strategy ensuring PMS data consistency across services. High-reliability financial infrastructure where correctness and auditability were non-negotiable.

events.title: Entrepreneur & Developer
events.description: Co-founded DALIN Software SA with three partners to pursue an idea well ahead of its time: an ontology-based intelligent datastore enabling semi-natural-language queries and real-time alert configuration over complex, multidimensional datasets. Prototyped a knowledge-based query interface in Java 2D, defined the full functional specifications for the NLP query system, and built the development environment from scratch. The venture wound down after seven months without securing funding — but the core idea proved prescient two decades before LLMs made natural-language data querying a mainstream expectation.

events.title: Sun Certified Programmer for the Java 2 Platform
events.description: Sun Certified Programmer for the Java 2 Platform (SCJP).

events.title: Senior Java Developer
events.description: Over three and a half years at Odyssey Financial Technologies (now part of Temenos), contributed analysis, architecture, and core development for a large-scale J2EE portfolio management platform serving private banking clients. Designed an XML data-exchange framework handling partial updates and structured import/export — a significant data interoperability challenge at a time when XML was an emerging standard. Built a business tag library bridging the web layer to EJB services, and took technical ownership of the EJB tier and deployment environment. Even as a developer, the work was firmly anchored in financial domain logic: data flows and integration patterns were designed around the business, not just the stack.

events.title: Java Developer
events.description: First professional role at a company whose core product was telecom market intelligence — serving professional analysts who produced strategic reports for the telecom industry. Within a 4-person team, migrated the analytical platform from 4D to Java/Web and co-designed a custom Syntagm database engine: a multidimensional index enabling flexible queries across geographic, financial, and equipment dimensions. An early, hands-on encounter with the architecture of analytical systems — years before OLAP tools became mainstream.

events.title: DESS — Computer Science (Algorithms, Languages, Databases)
events.description: One-year post-graduate degree in Computer Science with honours. Mention Très Bien. Covered algorithms, programming languages (Java, C++), database systems, operating systems, language processing, software engineering.

events.title: Thermal Engineer
events.description: First career role as a thermal engineer within a computation group delivering thermodynamic and fluid-mechanics analysis for large-scale construction projects. Worked on HVAC design for a nuclear-waste storage enclosure in Novosibirsk (Siberia), and on safety-critical tunnel smoke-evacuation systems modelled with SES — a sophisticated American FORTRAN program running 3D finite-element simulations across thermal conduction, convection, radiation, and fluid dynamics. Extended SES with new physical modules on a project-by-project basis, requiring deep fluency with its simulation internals. High-stakes engineering where analytical precision was non-negotiable — a foundation that shaped every subsequent approach to data and problem-solving.
